subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this draft remain open only until it produces baseline/candidate Telegram proof, or should maintainers accept another proof/boundary outcome for the generated-media wake-false fix?
rationale: Automation cannot decide whether a skipped Mantis run is acceptable proof for an internal media-delivery path, and the PR intentionally combines two split landing boundaries plus a stack-only commit.

options.title: Require combined visible proof
options.body: Keep the draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, logs, or live output shows main missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept internal-path proof
options.body: Maintainers can accept scheduler/source-level proof for this internal path and continue landing the two split PRs without visible Telegram media proof.

options.title: Close the proof stack
options.body: If the proof runner cannot exercise the scenario or the split PRs no longer need it, close this draft in favor of the canonical implementation and harness PRs.

recommendation.title: Require combined visible proof
recommendation.body: Keep the draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, logs, or live output shows main missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is centered on Telegram/Mantis proof coverage, and this handle has the strongest recent proof-runner history in the affected files.
